SonicWall firewalls targeted in ransomwa.summary:
【文章URL链接】：https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2025/08/04/sonicwall-firewalls-ssl-vpn-ransomware-akira/
【文章标题】：SonicWall firewalls targeted in ransomware attacks, possibly via zero-day
【文章摘要】：SonicWall firewalls have been targeted by ransomware attacks using the Akira ransomware, potentially exploiting a zero-day vulnerability. Attackers gained access through SonicWall SSL VPNs, compromising fully patched devices and quickly deploying ransomware. Organizations are advised to disable SSL VPN services and monitor for suspicious logins.

Akira 勒索软件疑似利用零日漏洞攻击已打补丁的 SonicWall VPN.summary:
【文章URL链接】：https://www.anquanke.com/post/id/310863
【文章标题】：Akira 勒索软件疑似利用零日漏洞攻击已打补丁的 SonicWall VPN 设备
【文章摘要】：Akira 勒索软件疑似利用零日漏洞攻击已打补丁的 SonicWall SSL VPN 设备，攻击者通过远程访问获取账户权限，随后进行勒索加密。建议企业暂时禁用 SonicWall SSL VPN 服务，并采取其他防护措施。
